correctness_gate.admission: Every candidate passes raw-child and ordinary-parent lanes for all 406 generation-3 public cases, 23 generation-4 endpoint cases, three deterministic hostiles, and every revealed generation-6 holdout case across two diagnostics modes, seven diagnostic profiles, and seven predecessor classes before any timing sample is retained.
correctness_gate.candidate_cost: The exact candidate.parser call is timed unchanged. Candidate-local diagnostic snapshot/restoration is candidate code and remains inside timing.
correctness_gate.harness_work: Fixture construction, pool restoration, global diagnostics toggles, assertions, comparisons, normalization, and result formatting are harness work outside timing.
correctness_gate.failure: Any throw, nonconformance, mode mismatch, root/hash drift, timer anomaly, or incomplete block invalidates the complete run. No partial candidate or round sample survives. The finally path disables diagnostics but does not rescue evidence.

corpus_order.base: materializePublicCases(g3 cases) exact return order; endpoint-cases.json array order; H-PREFIX-1M-TRUE, H-ASTRAL-PREFIX-1M-FALSE, H-CR-PREFIX-1M-TRUE; revealed holdout canonical array order

strict_parser_only_lane.variant_order: For one mode, form V with base case outermost, profile next, predecessor innermost in the exact listed order. Pool entry i is V[i mod V.length].
strict_parser_only_lane.construction: Preconstruct each ParserState with assigned source own-property/value, offset, predecessor, isError=false, furthest, expected own-property/reference/contents, suggestions array/reference/entry identities/fields, and secondarySpans array/reference/entry identities/fields.
strict_parser_only_lane.restoration: Restore every listed field including src and all reference identities before each candidate block, outside timing.
strict_parser_only_lane.timed_block: Start process.hrtime.bigint(); for i=0..49999 assign pool[i] = candidate.parser(pool[i]); stop. Candidate-internal work of every kind is included; no harness restoration occurs inside.
mode_block_sequence: call disableDiagnostics(); restore disabled pool; time disabled block
call enableDiagnostics(); restore enabled pool; time enabled block
call disableDiagnostics() after the enabled timer stops
strict_parser_only_lane.toggle_timing: All three toggles and both pool restorations are outside timing. The retained sample is disabled nanoseconds plus enabled nanoseconds from the same candidate/round.
strict_parser_only_lane.exception_rule: Wrap a complete run in try/finally solely to disable diagnostics. Any exception or incomplete block discards every sample and produces a RED run receipt.
strict_parser_only_lane.schedule: Round r uses row r mod 10 independently for warmup and measurement. Sixty measured rounds yield six complete cycles and exact position balance.

statistics.pairing: Pair summed disabled+enabled nanoseconds from the same measured round.
statistics.raw_report: All 60 disabled, enabled, and summed values per candidate in round order.
statistics.median: Sort ascending; for even N use arithmetic mean of elements N/2-1 and N/2.
statistics.mad: Median by the same rule over absolute deviations from the median.
statistics.paired_log_ratio: For ordered X:Y, ln(X summed ns / Y summed ns) for rounds 0..59.
statistics.bootstrap_prng: Unsigned-64 xoshiro256**. For each ordered pair independently, reset to base seed 0x42535452504e5354 and expand four state words with four standard SplitMix64 operations (increment 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15; multiply 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9 then 0x94d049bb133111eb; mask after every operation). Output rotl(s1*5,7)*9 and use the published reference transition.
statistics.bootstrap: For each ordered pair, start a fresh PRNG. For each of 10000 resamples draw exactly 60 indices as Number(nextUint64 % 60n), average its paired log-ratios, and continue only that pair's stream.
statistics.upper_endpoint: Sort 10000 means and take zero-based element 9499.
statistics.strict_win: Selected X wins only if each of its four ordered X:peer one-sided 95% upper endpoints is below 0. Otherwise performance is tied and cannot select.

descriptive_end_to_end_lane.operation: Use one prebuilt string(prefix).map(predecessor).next(candidate).skip(string(continuation)) parser per variant; inside timing construct one fresh ParserState and invoke the outer parser. Candidate-internal sandbox work is included; assertions are outside.
descriptive_end_to_end_lane.mode_and_candidate_order: Use the identical explicit disable/enable/disable sequence and ten-row candidate cycle; any exception invalidates the run.

allocation_sampling_lane.process: Fresh Node --expose-gc process per candidate; correctness and timing warmup first.
allocation_sampling_lane.tool: node:inspector HeapProfiler allocation sampling at 32768-byte interval
allocation_sampling_lane.procedure: Call global.gc(), start sampling, execute 20 disabled then 20 enabled parser-only 50000-state blocks with exact toggles and harness restoration between blocks, stop sampling, retain raw profile, and attribute bytes only to stacks containing the exact candidate target URL. Report harness/unattributed separately.
allocation_sampling_lane.unavailable: Report UNAVAILABLE with exact Node/V8 command and error; never substitute post-GC heapUsed deltas.

environment_receipt: Node/V8 versions, architecture/platform, CPU/core count, OS release and observable power state
active clean-base, package/lock/config, installed parse-that package/dist, feature/harness/corpus/holdout/candidate identities
canonical resolved roots from promotion verification
